azure.frontdoor.premium.base.note: Premium profile base fee, the same in every zone

azure.frontdoor.premium.zone1.requests.note: Premium requests served from edges in billing Zone 1 (North America, Europe, Middle East and Africa; the zone-to-geography mapping is not on the billing page and not machine-checked). Volume tiers count the requests of every profile to the zone in a month: from 250 million, 1 billion and 5 billion; the pricing page does not say whether the tiers count per profile, per region or per subscription, so they are pooled per region

azure.frontdoor.premium.zone1.transfer_o.note: Premium data transfer to clients served from edges in billing Zone 1 (North America, Europe, Middle East and Africa; the zone-to-geography mapping is not on the billing page and not machine-checked). Volume tiers count the transfer of every profile to the zone in a month: from 10 TB, 50 TB, 150 TB, 500 TB, 1 PB and 5 PB; the pricing page does not say whether the tiers count per profile, per region or per subscription, so they are pooled per region
